crownPassive.name: Aiaia
crownPassive.text: In rounds when you hold the Fate token, every enemy front-rank card is turned into a swine at upkeep and has 0 Attack that round.

bond.name: Guests of Aiaia
bond.text: Your other Hellas heroes have +1 Guard.

actions.name: Attack
actions.text: Standard attack: damage equal to Attack.

actions.name: Hex
actions.text: A Spell for 2 on any enemy card, ignoring Guard.

actions.name: Transfigure
